NotAdmin: Only the registry admin can do this.
NotOperator: This wallet is not an approved satellite operator.
NotScreener: Only approved conjunction screeners can do this.
ZeroAddress: That address is empty. Please paste a valid wallet address.
AlreadyOperator: That wallet is already an approved operator.
AlreadyScreener: That wallet is already an approved screener.
UnknownOperator: That wallet is not an active operator.
UnknownScreener: That wallet is not an active screener.
LabelInvalid: Names must be between 1 and 32 characters.
LabelTaken: A satellite with that label is already registered. Pick a different label.
UnknownSatellite: We could not find that satellite.
UnknownConjunction: We could not find that conjunction event.
SameSatellite: A conjunction needs two different satellites.
SameOperator: Both satellites belong to the same operator, so there is nothing to coordinate.
OperatorNotActive: One of the two operators is no longer active.
BadSchedule: The schedule is invalid. Commits, reveals and the closest approach must be in that order, each window at least the minimum length.
NotAParty: Your wallet does not operate either satellite in this event.
CommitWindowClosed: The commit window has closed. Decisions can no longer be sealed for this event.
TooManyCommits: You have reached the limit of re-commits for this event.
RevealNotOpen: Reveals open only after the commit window closes. Please wait.
RevealWindowClosed: The reveal window has closed for this event.
NoCommitment: You never sealed a decision for this event, so there is nothing to reveal.
AlreadyRevealed: You already revealed your decision for this event.
HashMismatch: That reveal does not match what you sealed. Check the action, plan fingerprint and secret salt.
TooEarlyToAttest: Observations can be reported only after the time of closest approach.
AttestWindowClosed: The observation window has closed for this event.
AlreadyAttested: Your screener wallet already reported an observation for this event.
NotFinalizable: This event cannot be finalized yet. It is still inside the observation window.
